real_defects.issue: analyze kept only the last stock row per SKU, but Shopify's inventory export has one row per variant per location: 40 units in a warehouse plus 5 in the shop read as 5 on hand, status reorder, order 51 (should be ok, order 0). Fixed: rows summed per SKU (cost/price from the first row that has one) with an info finding naming the merged SKUs.

Sales in the days before the oldest whole week were added into the oldest week's bin, so perfectly steady demand (2/day) over 66 or 69 days got 6 or 12 units of safety stock and a reorder point of 48 or 54 instead of 42. Fixed: only whole weeks feed the week-to-week variation.
